meta.name: ai-pdlc
meta.description: Run an AI-augmented Product Development Lifecycle that treats every phase as a hypothesis to test, not a deliverable to push: research, hypothesis, plan-by-phases, prototype, validate, implement under TDD, harden against the matching security track (OWASP/MASVS) and CVE risk, and ship with rollback and post-launch evaluation. Use as the strategic spine when a project is greenfield, a brownfield refactor, an experiment, or a feature whose value is not yet proven; cooperates with sdlc-orchestrator (operational chain) and hypothesis-validator (evidence).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品开发全流程变成可验证的假设并逐步推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想以假设驱动的方式管理产品开发，避免盲目堆功能
copy.tagline_en: Turn every product development phase into a testable hypothesis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to guide product development by evidence, not assumptions

howto.what: 把产品开发拆成多个阶段,每一阶段都当作待验证的假设:先做研究并写出可证伪的假设,再做原型,按测试驱动开发实现,按 OWASP/MASVS 做安全加固后发布,最后对照原假设评估。产出阶段清单、假设登记表、评审记录与交接说明。
howto.when: 当项目是全新开发、存量重构、实验等价值尚未验证的场景时。

say.text: 请用 ai-pdlc 规划这个新功能,先给出可证伪的假设和淘汰标准。
say.note: 会进入假设阶段,生成假设登记表。

say.text: 按 ai-pdlc 把产品开发拆成阶段,说明每阶段要证明什么。
say.note: 产出阶段阶梯和证据检查点。

say.text: 用 ai-pdlc 跑这个实验,从研究和原型开始。
say.note: 会拉取需求并开始原型环节。

howto.what_en: Breaks development into phases, each a falsifiable hypothesis to test: research, prototype, TDD implementation, OWASP/MASVS hardening, ship, then evaluate against hypotheses. Outputs phase ladder, hypotheses register, review notes, and handoff records.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the project is greenfield, a brownfield refactor, an experiment, or another scenario whose value is not yet proven.

say_en.text: Use ai-pdlc to plan this feature; start with falsifiable hypotheses.
Use ai-pdlc to phase the work; say what each phase must prove.
say_en.note: Outputs a phase ladder and evidence checkpoints.

say_en.text: Run this experiment through ai-pdlc, starting with research and prototype.
say_en.note: Starts the research and prototype loop.
